Doing a Face Mask Before Copycat (I'm 40, Let Me Live)
description:
A little pre-show before Copycat! I'm Lelac, aka BaoChickaWowWow. I spent the day in bed doing absolutely nothing, so before starting a very emotional cat game I'm doing a little self-care: a face mask (face, neck AND chest, because I'm 40 and that's how we do it).

I also share my little hack for the leftover serum in the packet.

Copycat Part 1 and Part 2 are up next, so don't miss them!
